why: The register gives Rocco Arena's father as FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA, marinaro, not Orazio. Act 45 of 1860 and act 228 of 1861 give Francesco Antonio and Serafina Arlotta a Giuseppe and a Rocco -- the same sibling pair the tree assigns to Orazio.
The register gives Rocco Arena's mother as SERAFINA ARLOTTA, not Giovana Zirilli. He named a daughter Serafina in New York in 1898, and an Arlotta was lodging with him there in 1900.
Act 45 of 1860 gives Giuseppe Arena's father as FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA. He is Rocco's elder brother by twenty-one months, and both were attached to the wrong father.
Act 45 of 1860 gives his mother as SERAFINA ARLOTTA.
Act 206 of 1883 names his mother GIOVANNA ROMANO, and the New Orleans manifest of 1908 -- taken from his own statement -- names her Giovanna Romano again. Two independent records on two continents.
